final_message:
I fixed the yen receipt bug, and all 18 tests now pass, including the yen receipt test.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 JPY showed as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a zero-decimal currency set (currently just `JPY`) that skips the division. 500 JPY now shows as `¥500`.

`formatMoney` is shared by invoices, cart, payments and admin, so yen amounts in those places will now display correctly too. I didn't check whether any of them were working around the old behavior.
